cases.name: quoted numeric wire names retain their spelling
cases.rust: pub struct Fixture { #[state(artifact)] #[value(rename = "2d")] pub part_2d: String, #[state(artifact)] #[value(rename = "3d")] pub part_3d: String, }

cases.name: canonical fields preserve numeric segments
cases.rust: #[value(rename_all = "camelCase")] pub struct Fixture { #[state(artifact)] pub f_c_0_k: f64, #[state(artifact)] pub part_2d: String, }
cases.typescript: export interface Fixture { fC0K: number; part2d: string; }

cases.name: explicit wire name overrides native field spelling
cases.rust: #[value(rename_all = "camelCase")] pub struct Fixture { #[state(artifact)] #[value(rename = "type")] pub kind: String, #[value(rename = "childId")] #[state(artifact)] pub child: String, }
cases.typescript: export interface Fixture { type: string; childId: string; }

cases.name: helpers and serde test attributes retain exact owner
cases.rust: pub struct Helper { pub locale: String, } pub struct Fixture { #[state(artifact)] #[cfg_attr(test, serde(rename = "nodeId"))] #[value(rename = "nodeId")] pub identifier: String, }
cases.typescript: export interface Helper { locale: string; } export interface Fixture { nodeId: string; }
